12-Sai. Torokeru Puzzle Futari no Harmon.summary: 12-Sai. Torokeru Puzzle Futari no Harmony is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Happinet, which was released in Japan in 2017.

Fire Emblem - Awakening.name: Fire Emblem Awakening
Fire Emblem - Awakening.summary:
Armies clash as the world burns. As an inevitable war draws ever closer, you must stand with Chrom and his forces--knights, mages, archers, and more--commanding them against the armies of kingdoms, empires, and the dead themselves.

Plan your strategery. Move your troops on the battlefield, then choose their weapon and attack. Using the new Pair Up and Dual systems, support your attacks with the help of nearby allies and watch their skills and relationships grow.

Mystery Case Files - Dire Grove.name: Mystery Case Files: Dire Grove
Mystery Case Files - Dire Grove.summary: Mystery Case Files: Dire Grove is an interactive movie puzzle adventure game developed by Big Fish Studios, and distributed by Big Fish Games. It is the sixth installment in the Mystery Case Files series. The game is available exclusively at Big Fish Games website. The Mystery Case Files franchise is the number one brand in casual games and has sold more than 2.5 million units to date.

Nobunaga no Yabou 2.name: Nobunaga no Yabou 2
Nobunaga no Yabou 2.summary: Nobunaga no Yabou 2 is an enhanced remake of Nobunaga no Yabou DS, which was an enhanced remake of Nobunaga no Yabou: Reppuuden.
